entities.name: Félix Amiot
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Félix Amiot was a French industrialist and aircraft constructor based in Colombes, France. Some of the aircraft models he designed served in the French Air Force during the Second World War. His second industrial activity was shipbuilding for fishing boats, sailing, and warship in Cherbourg. He became famous for designing and producing Missile Boat type "Combattante" which he sold worldwide.
